summary: Phase 2 AI Agent testing complete. All backend API tests passed (13/13). Step indicators in header correctly show all 6 create mode steps.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/agent/templates correctly returns 6 templates with id, name, description, icon, color, defaultConfig
GET /api/agent/courses correctly filters by createdByAgent flag and includes slidesCount
POST /api/agent/courses/{id}/analyze and apply-improvements correctly return 404 for non-existent projects
POST /api/agent/sessions/{id}/generate-structure correctly accepts optional templateId in body
Frontend ModeSelector component shows 'Criar Novo Curso' and 'Editar Curso Existente' cards with correct PT-BR text
Template selection correctly updates config fields (depth, duration, modules) and shows visual confirmation
Edit mode CourseListPanel correctly shows empty state with 'Nenhum curso criado pelo agente encontrado' message
Step indicators in header correctly show all 6 steps for create mode: Conteúdo, Análise, Configurar, Estrutura, Storyboard, Gerar Curso
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 features tested: 1) Templates endpoint returns 6 templates (onboarding, compliance, technical, soft_skills, health_safety, sales). 2) Agent courses endpoint returns empty list when no courses have createdByAgent flag. 3) Template selection UI works - clicking template updates config and shows checkmark. 4) Edit mode shows empty state message when no agent-created courses exist. The generate-structure endpoint accepts optional templateId in request body.
